_comment: Sets d'équipement. 'fr' = nom exact du client FR (vérifié sur le catalogue en jeu). 'pieces' : 2 ou 4 ; 'pieces_verified' false = à confirmer. 'en_mapping' : correspondance avec le nom anglais / Fribbels (certain | probable | inconnu). 'effect_en' et 'pieces' : base de données Hideout Guides (octobre 2026), qui sert aussi aux blasons téléchargés localement (sources/set_icons.py).

lifesteal.effect_en: Absorbs 20% of damage dealt as Health.

immunity.effect_en: Grants the caster immunity for 1 turn at the beginning of the battle. Does not stack with similar effects.

rage.effect_en: Damage dealt increases by 30% when attacking debuffed targets.

penetration.effect_en: When attacking with a Single Attack, penetrates the target's Defense by 15%. Does not stack with other sets of the same name.

revenge.effect_en: Speed increases by 12%, and for every 1% of Health lost, Speed increases by an additional 0.5%.

injury.effect_en: After attacking, decreases the target's max Health equal to damage dealt, by up to 6% (12% when using Single Attack).

protection.effect_en: At the start of battle, grants a barrier equivalent to 12% of the caster's max Health to all allies for 2 turns.

torrent.effect_en: Decreases Health by 10%, and when attacking, increases damage dealt by 10%.

riposte.effect_en: After successfully evading, has a 70% chance to counterattack.

pursuit.effect_en: Increases additional damage dealt by 20%. Does not stack with other sets of the same name.

weakening.effect_en: Increases Speed by 15%. Increases the chance to inflict debuffs by 15%.

warfare.effect_en: Increases Health by 20%. At the start of battle, resets skill cooldowns.

reversal.effect_en: Increases Speed by 15%. Upon reviving, increases Combat Readiness by 50%.

fervor.effect_en: At the start of an extra turn, increases the damage of the next attack by 20%. Does not stack with other sets of the same name.
